children.html:
Dive Into Greater Depths

PADI Deep Diving

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-68bb510f elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: At Mocean Beach Resort, our deep diving courses immerse certified divers into the thrill of exploring the ocean’s deeper realms. These experiences are designed for adventurous divers ready to become skilled deep divers under the guidance of experienced instructors. Dive with just two divers per guide for a personalized learning adventure. Expect encounters with vibrant marine life, including manta rays, reef sharks, and eagle rays, at depths reaching up to 40 meters. Our diver-centered facilities include private lockers, a wet area, and an air-conditioned camera room to ensure comfort and safety throughout every deep sea diving session.

Tailored Deep Diving Experiences

Your Deep Diving Course

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-4c24ef77 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: Each course spans two days and includes both theory and practical dives designed to develop deep diver skills. Divers practice descending, buoyancy control, navigation, and emergency procedures at increased depths. Instruction emphasizes safety, risk management, and situational awareness to ensure every diver feels confident. By the end of the course, participants will earn the PADI Deep Diver certification and have the skills to safely explore deeper marine environments.

After the Dive

Relax, Recharge, and Discover Sumbawa

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-e465c85 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: Your dive adventure doesn’t end when you surface. Mocean Beach Resort offers quiet beaches, breathtaking sunsets, and easy access to Sumbawa’s hidden gems. Spend an afternoon exploring nearby villages, trek to cascading waterfalls, or simply unwind with a spa treatment after a day of diving. Whether you crave exploration or pure relaxation, our boutique setting lets you enjoy Indonesia’s natural beauty at your own pace. Every stay is designed to refresh your body and inspire your next dive.

Journey Into Wild

Experience More Than Diving

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-96ba1d6 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: Beyond the crystal-clear waters, Sumbawa invites you to explore its wild side. Hike scenic coastal trails, visit traditional fishing villages, or take a day trip to secluded beaches where you can swim, snorkel, and soak in untouched beauty. For those seeking culture, local markets and ceremonies reveal the island’s rich heritage. Whether you’re chasing adrenaline or peaceful escapes, every moment here adds a new layer to your Indonesian journey.

children.html:
Who can join the Deep Diving course?

Certified divers with Open Water or Advanced Open Water qualifications can participate.

What depths will I explore?

Courses safely take divers down to 40 meters, with gradual skill-building and supervision.

How large are the training groups?

Groups are capped at two divers per instructor for personalized guidance and attention.

What skills are covered in the course?

Divers practice deep descent techniques, buoyancy control, navigation, and emergency procedures.

Are the facilities equipped for deep diving?

Yes. Our dive center has private lockers, wet areas, and an air-conditioned camera room to support your training.
